verdict: Leads are steady and efficient; intake and organic visibility need attention.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 165 leads at a cost of $12.96 per lead — well below historical targets — and both spend and leads held nearly flat week-over-week, confirming the Meta campaign is running efficiently. The gap to address is downstream: roughly 18% of those leads are not becoming active pipeline entries in your CRM, which is a contact and intake process issue, not an ads problem. Separately, Google Business Profile actions dropped sharply over the last 7 days, including three consecutive days of zero activity, pointing to a real dip in organic search visibility that we are monitoring closely. On the intake side, we are actively working to close the automation gaps — SMS follow-up, call access, and CRM logging — that have been holding back your contact rate. Resolving those items is the clearest path to turning more of your current lead volume into cases.

highlights.phrase: leads received in the last 28 days from Meta advertising
cost per lead this period, well below your historical ceiling
drop in Google Business Profile actions over the last 7 days

watch_item.issue: Roughly 30 leads this period did not convert into CRM pipeline entries, and Google Business Profile organic activity has gone quiet for three consecutive days.
watch_item.fix: SMS automation, CRM auto-logging, and call access are being brought live this week to close the intake gap; GBP activity is under active monitoring to identify and reverse the visibility drop.
